meaning.en: In high spirits; delighted and excited.
meaning.zh: 原指文章志趣高超，言辞犀利。现形容兴致高，情绪热烈。

examples.zh: 孩子们兴高采烈地去春游了。
examples.en: The children set off on their spring outing in high spirits.

examples.zh: 拿到录取通知书，她兴高采烈地给家里打电话。
examples.en: When she got her acceptance letter, she called home, thrilled to bits.

origin.source: 南朝梁·刘勰《文心雕龙·体性》

story.en: Liu Xie said the poet Ji Kang was gallant and bold, "so his mood is lofty and his style fiery" (兴高而采烈) — originally about writing style.
story.zh: 刘勰《文心雕龙》："叔夜俊侠，故兴高而采烈。"原评嵇康文风。

usage.en: Usually adverbial (兴高采烈地). 兴 is xìng (mood), not xīng.
usage.zh: 多作状语。"兴"读 xìng。

meaning.en: To speak with calm confidence and fluency.
meaning.zh: 理直气壮、从容不迫地说话。

examples.zh: 面试时，她侃侃而谈，给考官留下了深刻印象。
examples.en: In the interview she spoke with ease and made a strong impression.

examples.zh: 一说到历史，他就侃侃而谈。
examples.en: Get him on to history and he'll hold forth confidently.

story.en: The Analects describe Confucius at court: "speaking with the lower officials, he was frank and composed" (与下大夫言，侃侃如也).
story.zh: 《论语·乡党》："朝，与下大夫言，侃侃如也。"

usage.en: Predicate. Praises composure; unlike 夸夸其谈 (empty talk) it is positive.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，褒义，与贬义的"夸夸其谈"不同。

meaning.en: Aggressive and overbearing; pressing hard on others.
meaning.zh: 形容气势汹汹，盛气凌人，使人难堪。

examples.zh: 他说话咄咄逼人，让对方很不舒服。
examples.en: His aggressive way of talking made the other side uncomfortable.

examples.zh: 记者咄咄逼人地追问部长。
examples.en: The journalist pressed the minister aggressively.

origin.source: 南朝宋·刘义庆《世说新语·排调》

story.en: In a game of making up alarming lines, someone's verse was so startling that Yin Zhongkan exclaimed "Menacing! It presses on a person!" (咄咄逼人).
story.zh: 《世说新语·排调》中，众人作"危语"，殷仲堪听后惊呼："咄咄逼人！"

usage.en: Predicate, adverbial or attributive. About tone, questioning and attitude; also a strong rising trend (来势咄咄逼人).
usage.zh: 多作谓语、状语、定语，形容语气、态度或来势。

natural: A thousand pieces all in one pattern

meaning.en: Monotonously the same; stereotyped and lacking variety.
meaning.zh: 一千篇文章都一个样子。比喻文章或事物都套用一个格式，毫无变化。

examples.zh: 这些电视剧情节千篇一律，没什么新意。
examples.en: These TV dramas all have the same formulaic plots — nothing new.

examples.zh: 很多城市的新区千篇一律，缺少特色。
examples.en: Many cities' new districts look cookie-cutter, lacking character.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive. Criticises writing, design, products and cities.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语，批评文章、设计、产品等。

natural: Even an inch is hard to move

meaning.en: Unable to move a step; stuck in a difficult situation.
meaning.zh: 连一步也难以前进。形容走路困难，也比喻处境艰难。

equivalents: without a leg to stand on

examples.zh: 大雪封路，车辆寸步难行。
examples.en: The snow blocked the roads and traffic couldn't move an inch.

examples.zh: 在国外不懂语言，简直寸步难行。
examples.en: Without the language, you can barely get anywhere abroad.

usage.en: Predicate. Literal or figurative (no money, no language, no connections).
usage.zh: 多作谓语，可实指也可比喻处境困难。

meaning.en: Wide-eyed and speechless with shock or amazement.
meaning.zh: 瞪着眼睛说不出话来，形容受窘或惊呆的样子。

examples.zh: 这个价格让人瞠目结舌。
examples.en: The price left people speechless.

examples.zh: 他的回答让在场的人瞠目结舌。
examples.en: His answer left everyone present dumbfounded.

usage.en: Predicate. More literary than 目瞪口呆; 瞠 is chēng.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，比"目瞪口呆"书面。"瞠"读 chēng。

meaning.en: To pool everyone's wisdom and effort.
meaning.zh: 大家共同出主意，共同出力量。

examples.zh: 只要群策群力，没有克服不了的困难。
examples.en: If we all pull together, there's no difficulty we can't overcome.

examples.zh: 这个项目是全体员工群策群力的成果。
examples.en: This project is the result of a team effort by all the staff.

story.en: Yang Xiong said the founder of the Han won because he used "the strategies of the many and the strength of the many" (群策屈群力).
story.zh: 扬雄《法言·重黎》："汉屈群策，群策屈群力。"

date.zh: 西汉末至新 · 前1—1世纪
date.en: late Western Han to Xin, 1st c. BC–1st c. AD

usage.en: Predicate. Common in workplace and official language.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常用于单位、公文。

meaning.en: To rush forward all at once; to swarm.
meaning.zh: 形容很多人一下子都围拢上去。

examples.zh: 明星一出现，粉丝们就一拥而上。
examples.en: As soon as the star appeared, the fans swarmed forward.

examples.zh: 某个行业一赚钱，大家就一拥而上，结果产能过剩。
examples.en: As soon as an industry makes money, everyone piles in and it ends up with overcapacity.

usage.en: Predicate. Also critical of herd behaviour in business. In speech 一 is yì.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，也用来批评盲目跟风。

natural: When the pain has passed, reflect on it

meaning.en: To reflect on a painful experience once it is over, so as to learn from it.
meaning.zh: 悲痛的心情平静以后，再追想当时的痛苦。指吸取教训。

examples.zh: 痛定思痛，他决定戒烟。
examples.en: Looking back on the scare, he decided to quit smoking.

examples.zh: 惨败之后，球队痛定思痛，进行了全面改革。
examples.en: After the crushing defeat, the team took stock and carried out sweeping reforms.

story.en: Han Yu wrote that "a person whose pain has settled thinks back on the time of pain" (痛定之人，思当痛之时), and so feels it more keenly.
story.zh: 韩愈《与李翱书》："痛定之人，思当痛之时，不知何能自处也。"

usage.en: Predicate or as an opening clause. Usually followed by a resolution or reform.
usage.zh: 多作谓语或句首，后面常接决心或改革。

meaning.en: Countless; too many to count.
meaning.zh: 数也数不过来，形容数量极多。

equivalents: more than you can shake a stick at

examples.zh: 这座城市的小吃数不胜数。
examples.en: The city has more street snacks than you could count.

examples.zh: 他获得的奖项数不胜数。
examples.en: He has won countless awards.

usage.en: Predicate. 数 is shǔ (to count), not shù.
usage.zh: 多作谓语。"数"读 shǔ。

meaning.en: Self-sufficient; producing everything one needs oneself.
meaning.zh: 依靠自己的生产，满足自己的需要。

examples.zh: 过去的农民过着自给自足的生活。
examples.en: Farmers in the past lived self-sufficient lives.

examples.zh: 这个国家的粮食基本能自给自足。
examples.en: The country is largely self-sufficient in grain.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive (自给自足的经济). 给 is jǐ here, not gěi.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语。"给"读 jǐ。

natural: Pleasing to the heart and the eyes

meaning.en: Pleasing to the eye and delightful to the mind.
meaning.zh: 看到美好的景物而心情舒畅。

examples.zh: 公园里花团锦簇，令人赏心悦目。
examples.en: The park is a mass of flowers — a feast for the eyes.

examples.zh: 这本书排版干净，读起来赏心悦目。
examples.en: The book's layout is clean and a pleasure to read.

usage.en: Predicate, often 令人赏心悦目. About scenery, design and performances.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常用"令人赏心悦目"。

meaning.en: Day and night; working round the clock.
meaning.zh: 用夜晚接上白天。形容日夜不停地工作或学习。

examples.zh: 工人们夜以继日地抢修，终于恢复了供电。
examples.en: Workers repaired the lines round the clock and finally restored power.

examples.zh: 为了完成论文，她夜以继日地工作。
examples.en: She worked day and night to finish her thesis.

story.en: Mencius describes the Duke of Zhou: when something didn't fit, "he would look up and ponder it, night continuing on from day" (仰而思之，夜以继日).
story.zh: 《孟子》写周公："其有不合者，仰而思之，夜以继日。"

usage.en: Usually adverbial (夜以继日地工作). Common in news.
usage.zh: 多作状语，新闻中常用。

natural: Nowhere to put one's hands and feet

meaning.en: At a loss what to do; flustered.
meaning.zh: 手脚不知放在哪里好。形容举动慌乱或没有办法应付。

equivalents: like a deer in the headlights

examples.zh: 第一次当众发言，他紧张得手足无措。
examples.en: Speaking in public for the first time, he was so nervous he didn't know what to do with himself.

examples.zh: 面对突如其来的停电，大家手足无措。
examples.en: When the power suddenly went out, everyone was at a loss.

usage.en: Predicate or complement (紧张得手足无措).
usage.zh: 多作谓语、补语。

meaning.en: Overjoyed at an unexpected piece of good luck.
meaning.zh: 遇到意想不到的喜事而特别高兴。

examples.zh: 收到老朋友的来信，他喜出望外。
examples.en: He was overjoyed to get a letter from an old friend.

examples.zh: 没想到能抽中大奖，她喜出望外。
examples.en: She never expected to win the top prize and was over the moon.

usage.en: Predicate. Stresses that the good news was unexpected.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，强调出乎意料。

natural: Fight for every morning and evening

meaning.en: To seize every moment; to act with great urgency.
meaning.zh: 只争取一朝一夕的时间。形容抓紧时间。

examples.zh: 离比赛只有一个月了，我们要只争朝夕。
examples.en: There's only a month until the competition — every day counts.

examples.zh: 科研工作需要只争朝夕的精神。
examples.en: Scientific research needs a spirit of urgency.

origin.source: 毛泽东《满江红·和郭沫若同志》（1963）

story.en: A line from a 1963 poem by Mao Zedong: "Ten thousand years is too long; seize the morning and evening" (一万年太久，只争朝夕).
story.zh: 出自毛泽东1963年词《满江红·和郭沫若同志》："一万年太久，只争朝夕。"

usage.en: Predicate or attributive. 朝 is zhāo (morning). Popular in 20th-century and official language.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语。"朝"读 zhāo。

meaning.en: Taken completely by surprise; caught off guard.
meaning.zh: 事情来得突然，来不及防备。

examples.zh: 这场暴雨来得猝不及防，很多人被淋湿了。
examples.en: The storm came out of the blue and lots of people got soaked.

examples.zh: 对手突然进攻，让我们猝不及防。
examples.en: The opponent's sudden attack caught us off guard.

usage.en: Predicate or adverbial. 猝 is cù.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、状语。"猝"读 cù。

meaning.en: Remarkably lifelike; an uncanny likeness.
meaning.zh: 形容描写或模仿得非常好，非常逼真。

examples.zh: 他模仿老师说话惟妙惟肖，大家都笑了。
examples.en: His impression of the teacher was spot-on, and everyone laughed.

examples.zh: 这些泥人雕刻得惟妙惟肖。
examples.en: These clay figures are remarkably lifelike.

usage.en: Predicate or complement (模仿得惟妙惟肖). About imitation, portraits and craftsmanship.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、补语，用于模仿、刻画。

meaning.en: Full of joy; a festive, happy atmosphere.
meaning.zh: 形容非常欢乐的样子或气氛。

examples.zh: 过年了，家家户户喜气洋洋。
examples.en: It's New Year, and every household is in a festive mood.

examples.zh: 新郎新娘喜气洋洋地向客人敬酒。
examples.en: The bride and groom, all smiles, toasted their guests.

usage.en: Predicate, attributive or adverbial. Festivals, weddings, good news.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语、状语，多用于节日、婚礼。

meaning.en: To support oneself by one's own work.
meaning.zh: 凭自己的劳动养活自己。

equivalents: stand on one's own two feet

examples.zh: 他虽然残疾，却一直自食其力。
examples.en: Despite his disability, he has always supported himself.

examples.zh: 年轻人毕业后应该自食其力。
examples.en: Young people should pay their own way after graduating.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive. Praises independence.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语，称赞独立。

natural: Teaching by word and by example

meaning.en: To teach by both word and personal example.
meaning.zh: 一面用言语来教导，一面用行动来示范。

examples.zh: 父母的言传身教对孩子影响很大。
examples.en: What parents say and the example they set have a big influence on children.

examples.zh: 老师不仅要讲道理，更要言传身教。
examples.en: Teachers should not only explain but also lead by example.

usage.en: Subject, object or predicate. Common about parents and teachers.
usage.zh: 多作主语、宾语、谓语，多用于父母、老师。

meaning.en: Approachable and easy to get along with; down-to-earth.
meaning.zh: 态度和蔼，使人容易接近。也指文字浅显，容易了解。

examples.zh: 校长平易近人，同学们都喜欢找他聊天。
examples.en: The headteacher is very approachable — students love chatting with him.

examples.zh: 虽然很有名，她却十分平易近人。
examples.en: Although she's famous, she's very down-to-earth.

story.en: The Duke of Zhou said that if government is "calm, easy and close to the people" (平易近民), the people will turn to it.
story.zh: 《史记·鲁周公世家》："平易近民，民必归之。"

usage.en: Predicate or attributive. Usually praises someone of high status.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语，多称赞地位高的人。

meaning.en: From far away; travelling a very long distance.
meaning.zh: 形容路途遥远。

equivalents: from the far ends of the earth

examples.zh: 他千里迢迢从新疆赶来参加婚礼。
examples.en: He came all the way from Xinjiang for the wedding.

examples.zh: 千里迢迢来到这里，一定要好好玩玩。
examples.en: Now that we've come all this way, we should make the most of it.

usage.en: Usually adverbial before a verb of travel (千里迢迢地赶来).
usage.zh: 多作状语，修饰"赶来、来到"等。

natural: Blending it all together and seeing it through

meaning.en: To absorb knowledge thoroughly and connect it into a whole.
meaning.zh: 把各方面的知识和道理融合贯穿起来，得到全面透彻的理解。

examples.zh: 学习不能死记硬背，要融会贯通。
examples.en: Don't just learn by rote — make the connections and understand it as a whole.

examples.zh: 他把中西医融会贯通，形成了自己的疗法。
examples.en: He combined Chinese and Western medicine into a method of his own.

usage.en: Predicate. About study and mastering a subject.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，用于学习和掌握知识。

natural: What the mind wants, the hand does

meaning.en: With great skill and ease; doing something effortlessly.
meaning.zh: 心里怎么想，手就能怎么做。比喻技艺纯熟，做起来很顺手。

examples.zh: 做了十年会计，他处理这些账目得心应手。
examples.en: After ten years as an accountant, handling these accounts is second nature to him.

examples.zh: 换了新电脑，用起来更得心应手了。
examples.en: With the new computer, everything is much easier to do.

story.en: The wheelwright Bian tells a duke that the skill of carving wheels "is got in the hand and answered by the heart" (得之于手而应于心) and cannot be put into words.
story.zh: 《庄子·天道》中轮扁说斫轮之术"不徐不疾，得之于手而应于心"。

date.zh: 战国中期 · 前4—前3世纪

usage.en: Predicate or complement (用得得心应手). About tools, skills and work.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、补语，用于工具、技能、工作。
